text:
lia: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — want to lock owners and minimal timelines for the vendor & auth action items so we can close INC-2026-45. Recurring theme: cloud auth flakiness + model-registry token expiry cascade. Assigning a short sync at 10:00 PT.

devon: I'll take the staged failover plan for auth: create a passive secondary auth provider config and an automated switch gate. Deliverable: design doc + demo in staging. ETA: 5 business days.

sophia: I'll scope the infra client changes: structured retry policy + per-endpoint circuit breaker + metrics (auth.failure_reason). Plan: open PR to infra-auth-client repo, include toggles. ETA: 48h.

jordan: Security notes: we need immediate rotation for the vendor integration tokens and a GH action to validate post-rotation smoke tests. I'll create rotation runbook and the smoke-test checklist. ETA: 72h.

ash: (eng-ml) I'll collaborate with devon on the passive fallback for model-registry calls, also working on a lightweight in-process cache to avoid reads during vendor auth hot-fail windows. Prototype ETA: 1 week.

ash: quick pseudo for cache TTL + degraded-path gating:
```
if (vendor_auth_unavailable && cache_hit) {
  return cached_model_manifest;
}
```

lia: I'll own the customer-impact tracking doc and the internal timeline for external comms. PMs — @pm-ryan can you draft the external note templates so we can reuse them? ETA: EOD tomorrow for internal draft.

pm-ryan: On it. I'll prepare SLAs/options for vendor escalation (1) demand better SLO, (2) shift auth to internal provider, (3) multi-vendor auth plan. Will present cost/impact tradeoffs. ETA: next Tue.

devon: Also propose a quarterly vendor reliability review (include auth & model-registry vendors) in our vendor TG. Add as a recurring calendar item?

jordan: Yes, add that. Security will provide a vendor-risk scorecard to feed the review.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT:INC-2026-45-followups created and assigned. Reminder set for 72h.

sophia: small detail: adding an X-Auth-Trace header and logging vendor error payloads will help debug root cause quickly. I'll include this in the PR.

lia: I'll post the action tracker after the sync with owners, GH issues, and ETA fields. Please flag any constraints now.

devon: One constraint: we need KMS access in staging to validate token rotation; infra please expedite.

ash: noted, I'll coordinate with infra to get staging KMS creds.

(End of thread)
